about: Public LanaCoin mainnet transactions for lana-tx tests: raw bytes exactly as Electrum returned them, keyed by txid. Each case is a transaction whose shape the library must read, re-encode, hash and check; every transaction it spends is here too, so prevout values, scripts and nTimes come from re-hashed bytes, never from a number. Public chain data only: no key, no name.

fetched.note: Fetched read-only from electrum1 and compared byte for byte with electrum2; both returned the same bytes for every transaction.

cases.name: ld-auto-send
cases.what: lana.discount buyback auto-send of 3 Sep 2026: 98 payouts in 28 whole purchases, then change back to the buyback wallet. One input, uncompressed key.

cases.name: ld-batch-send
cases.what: lana.discount manual batch of 3 Sep 2026: 4 payouts, then change back to the buyback wallet. One input, uncompressed key.

cases.name: ld-consolidation
cases.what: Consolidation of the lana.discount buyback wallet: 20 coins (MAX_INPUTS) into one output to the same address.

cases.name: wallet-12-inputs
cases.builder: unknown, fee by the x150 rule
cases.what: Twelve coins from one compressed-key wallet: one payment, then change back to the same wallet.

cases.name: lc-card-payment
cases.what: card.lanapays.us payment for a 78.13 LANA bundle (the lana-cards server/lib/lanaTx.test.ts fixture): four coins from one compressed key, the provider, then change. Its fee follows lana-cards' x100 rule, not LD's x150.
